card.climb: from the deepest node holding the finding, as partition_measure.path_to_statement finds it, through each parent to the first node a construct names; a statement, with item or except handler entered by a field outside body, cases, finalbody, handlers, items, names, optional_vars, orelse, target, targets, or a def, class, lambda or module reached first, holds the finding inside no construct; a for header and a while test belong to their loop
card.construct_nodes: each sigil's own tier 2 test: code_collection._is_collection, code_flow.FLOW_NODES, code_import.IMPORT_NODES, code_loop.LOOP_NODES, code_variable.BINDING_NODES
card.forms: a rule on a construct whose page ruff_rules.rule_page cannot read carries no_forms
card.keys: partition.json: a rule whose imports key opens on 'the finding sits on an import statement' sits on the import construct; a rule whose reach ground is unparse, or whose file kinds lack source, sits on none; its preview flag carries over
